spec.title: Setup: build Eclipse Collections at both #786 revisions and run the UnifiedMap-family tests of unit-tests-java8
spec.description: Setup for case J17 of llm-dlc/loops/organic-java-pr-product-behaviour-20-additional-cases.md, no claims. In the setup worktrees under ~/.cache/in-the-loop/organic-pr-20/worktrees (J17-eclipse-collections-fix = 7ce7a197, J17-eclipse-collections-parent = 9084111e), builds unit-tests-java8 with -am (code generator, its Maven plugin, api, impl, testutils, junit-trait-runner) with Maven 3.10.0 on JDK 8 (upstream CI uses JDK 8), install into the cache's own m2 (first step online, the rest offline). Runs the ten concrete test classes that implement MutableMapIterableTestCase (UnifiedMapTest,UnifiedMapNoIteratorTest,UnifiedMapWithHashingStrategyTest,UnifiedMapWithHashingStrategyNoIteratorTest,UnmodifiableMutableMapTest,SynchronizedMutableMapTest,MapAdapterTest,ConcurrentHashMapTest,ConcurrentHashMapUnsafeTest,ConcurrentMutableHashMapTest) on each side, then the landed MutableMapIterableTestCase transplanted onto the parent: #786 is a preservation optimization, so the landed collision assertions are expected to pass there too. Jars and the UnifiedMap class digest to .../artifacts and the log, JUnit summaries to .../logs, build trees removed. Results go into llm-dlc/loops/organic-java-pr-product-behaviour-20-additional-cases-setup.md.
spec.expected: every step exits 0: the map tests pass on both sides, with the landed test transplanted onto the parent as well
